steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Pre-chill necessary equipment and prepare cleaning solutions.

substeps.instruction: Pre-chill swinging bucket centrifuge and fixed angle centrifuge to 4°C.
Pre-chill dounces, pestles, and tubes to 4°C on ice.
Fill a 2 L beaker with 500 mL sterile water to soak used dounces.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt frozen tissue to release nuclei using a Dounce homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Place 20-50 mg frozen or crushed tissue into a pre-chilled 7 mL dounce containing 1 mL cold 1x HB.
Dounce with 'A' loose pestle until resistance goes away (~10 strokes).
Dounce with 'B' tight pestle until resistance goes away (~15 strokes).
Place 'A' and 'B' pestles into sterile water to soak for cleaning.
Filter the homogenate during transfer into a FACS tube.
Place the Dounce into the beaker with sterile water to soak for cleaning.

steps.title: Isolate and Resuspend Nuclei
steps.instruction: Pellet the nuclei and prepare them for the density gradient.

substeps.instruction: Spin at 350 xg for 5 min at 4°C in a fixed angle centrifuge to pellet nuclei.
Remove 950 uL of supernatant, leaving 50 uL remaining.
Gently resuspend nuclei in 350 uL 1x HB.

steps.title: Prepare Iodixanol Density Gradient
steps.instruction: Create a layered iodixanol gradient for nuclei purification.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 volume (400 uL) of 50% Iodixanol solution and mix by pipetting.
Slowly layer 600 uL of 30% Iodixanol solution under the 25% mixture, wiping the pipette tip with a kimwipe to avoid mixing layers.
Layer 600 uL of 40% Iodixanol solution under the 30% mixture, wiping the pipette tip with a kimwipe to avoid mixing layers.
Spin in a pre-chilled swinging bucket centrifuge for 20 min at 4°C at 3000 xg with the brake off.
Set acceleration level to 1 and deceleration to 0 (total centrifuge time = 23 min, time to stop = 13 min).

steps.title: Extract and Wash Nuclei
steps.instruction: Recover the nuclei band and remove iodixanol.

substeps.instruction: Slowly extract top layers in 200 uL increments until reaching the 200-300 uL nuclei band located between the 30% and 40% interface.
Transfer 200 uL of the nuclei band into a 1.5 mL LoBind tube.
Dilute nuclei by adding 200 uL of wash buffer and mix by pipetting.
Count nuclei using trypan blue.

steps.title: Final Pellet and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Concentrate nuclei and resuspend in the final buffer.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 500 xg for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant without disrupting the pellet.
Resuspend in x uL of chilled Nuclei Buffer (volume determined by downstream application) to achieve target concentration based on the count.
